Thanks for giving bingd a shot!

Beli changed the way I experienced restaurants. I went from eating out
occasionally to ranking every place, comparing lists with friends, and
hunting for the next spot.

I built bingd because I wanted that same post-watch ritual for movies
and TV: rank what you watch, compare taste with friends, and keep the
fun going after the credits roll.

If you have feature suggestions, something in the app is confusing, or
you just want to say hi, reply to this email. It comes straight to me.

bingd is more fun with friends, so here's your invite link
(https://bingd.app/i/{{inviteToken}}). And if you want to see what I'm
watching, follow me on bingd (https://bingd.app/u/surajkan).

Hope you enjoy it as much as I do.

Happy binging,
Suraj
